en.text: SpaceX came within weeks of bankruptcy in 2008. The fourth Falcon 1 launch was our last shot.

zh.text: SpaceX在2008年距离破产只有几周时间。第四次猎鹰1号发射是我们最后的机会。

en.text: I put all my PayPal money into SpaceX, Tesla, and SolarCity. I didn't expect to make any money back.

zh.text: 我把所有的PayPal钱都投入了SpaceX、Tesla和SolarCity。我没指望能拿回任何钱。

en.text: Tesla went through production hell with the Model 3. There were times I slept on the factory floor.

zh.text: Tesla在Model 3上经历了生产地狱。有时候我睡在工厂地板上。

en.text: I was renting money to pay rent. That's how close I was to going under.

zh.text: 我在借钱付房租。我离垮掉就是那么近。

en.text: Starting a company is like eating glass and staring into the abyss.

zh.text: 创办公司就像吃玻璃和凝视深渊。

en.text: There were times at Tesla where I had to borrow money from friends to pay rent.

zh.text: 在Tesla有些时候我不得不向朋友借钱付房租。

en.text: I didn't start these companies to build an empire. I started them to solve problems.

zh.text: 我创办这些公司不是为了建立帝国。我创办它们是为了解决问题。

en.text: The probability of SpaceX succeeding when I started it was maybe 10 percent. I thought it was worth the risk.

zh.text: 我创办SpaceX时它成功的概率大概只有10%。我认为这个风险值得冒。

en.text: I think a SpaceX IPO is possible, but it's not a priority. We need Mars first.

zh.text: 我认为SpaceX IPO是可能的，但这不是优先事项。我们需要先解决火星。

en.text: The xAI and X merger discussions are about creating the most efficient information and AI company.

zh.text: xAI和X的合并讨论是为了创建最高效的信息和AI公司。

en.text: I've put over $100 million of my own money into SpaceX and Tesla combined in the early days.

zh.text: 在早期我总共向SpaceX和Tesla投入了超过1亿美元的个人资金。

en.text: The car industry told me electric vehicles would never work. They were wrong.

zh.text: 汽车行业告诉我电动汽车永远不会成功。他们错了。

en.text: My companies have lost billions of dollars. But I never bet more than I could afford to lose.

zh.text: 我的公司亏损了数十亿美元。但我从不赌超过我能承受损失的金额。

en.text: The biggest risk to Tesla is not a competitor. It's our own execution.

zh.text: Tesla最大的风险不是竞争对手。而是我们自己的执行力。

en.text: I think Twitter/X was a good acquisition. It's the town square of the internet.

zh.text: 我认为Twitter/X是一个好的收购。它是互联网的公共广场。

en.text: The $44 billion I paid for Twitter was a lot of money, but free speech is worth it.

zh.text: 我花440亿美元买Twitter是一大笔钱，但言论自由值得。

en.text: I think the best businesses are the ones that solve the hardest problems.

zh.text: 我认为最好的企业是那些解决最难问题的企业。

en.text: If you're going to build a company, you might as well build one that changes the world.

zh.text: 如果你要创办一家公司，不如创办一家改变世界的公司。

en.text: The early days of Tesla were brutal. We almost ran out of money multiple times.

zh.text: Tesla的早期是残酷的。我们多次差点用完钱。

en.text: I think the combination of xAI, X, and Tesla creates the most powerful AI ecosystem in the world.

zh.text: 我认为xAI、X和Tesla的组合创造了世界上最强大的AI生态系统。
